The pilot has a broad s_grad span and monotone-concave signature, while the verified readout is reduced/static; no unresolved temporal trajectory ambiguity is indicated.
Its max(0, k*(u_now-s_grad)) form conflicts with the observed smooth, monotone-concave response and the verified sink-gradient siphon mechanism.
The source notes explicitly say it fails when s_grad varies; observed sink-gradient response and the provided source mechanism require the attenuation factor.
